current_admission.reason: No same-snapshot M54-core versus M66-core DC, two-corner STA and per-arm Formality A/B receipt exists yet.

forbidden_m66_bridge.reason: It adds twelve 64-bit telemetry counters, maxima state and extra top ports and therefore invalidates core-to-core area and timing fairness.

functional_rtl_delta: M66 permits a nonzero next launch when final_response_success is true.
M66 keeps active_q asserted when that same-edge launch is accepted.

primetime.note: The previously guessed /opt/synopsys/pts/V-2023.12-SP3 path is absent on this host.

the slow and fast TSMC28 DB files
tool launcher paths, launcher SHA256 values and version output
run_order: freeze and verify one prelaunch manifest
run M54 DC in an isolated work directory
run M66 DC with the byte-identical script, SDC, libraries and options in a second isolated work directory
run PrimeTime setup at ssg0p9v125c and hold at ffg1p05vm40c on each mapped netlist
run M54 RTL-to-M54-netlist Formality using the M54 SVF
run M66 RTL-to-M66-netlist Formality using the M66 SVF
independently parse raw reports, validate the receipt and seal the directory
same_compile_recipe: analyze SystemVerilog with the frozen default parameters
elaborate only the declared raw core top
set slow target library and paired fast minimum library
apply the one common SDC without arm-specific exceptions
compile_ultra then identical incremental optimization and hold fixing
write mapped Verilog, DDC, mapped SDC and the arm-specific SVF
forbidden: M66 telemetry bridge as the M66 synthesis top
different SDC or compile options between arms
different library bytes or operating conditions between arms
cross-variant M54-to-M66 Formality as a substitute for two per-arm implementation checks
overwriting an existing run or receipt
claiming physical die, SRAM, pad, power or system results from this prelayout core A/B

required_fail_closed_checks: one and only one clock exists at 3.000 ns
every nonclock input has an input delay and transition
every output has an output delay and load
check_timing reports no missing clock, no_input_delay, no_output_delay, unconstrained endpoint or combinational loop
setup and hold analysis coverage and constraint-violator reports are emitted for both arms
the post-elaboration top port signature is byte-identical between arms

large_io_interpretation.decision: Keep the identical raw-core ports for the primary incremental A/B and do not add boundary registers or pad cells to one arm.
large_io_interpretation.rationale: The 10658 signal-bit interface is identical and is part of the core contract. Adding more than ten thousand boundary flops would mask the very small lookahead delta.
large_io_interpretation.paper_language: logic-only prelayout core cell area with modeled input transition and output load; I/O pad area, package feasibility and routed wire delay excluded
large_io_interpretation.required_sensitivity: Report reg-to-reg, input-to-reg, reg-to-output and input-to-output path groups separately so a large-I/O critical path cannot be silently presented as an internal-core Fmax.

formality_contract.m54_svf: the M54 SVF emitted before analyze and closed only after mapped outputs are written

zero failing, aborted and unverified compare points

P0.finding: No exact-SHA same-snapshot M54-core versus M66-core DC, two-corner STA and per-arm Formality result is currently present.
P0.impact: No M66 area overhead, fixed-3ns timing delta or timing-qualified throughput claim is presently citable.
P0.closure: Complete and independently validate the recommended A/B run and fail-closed receipt.

P0.finding: The existing M66 schedule bridge adds telemetry state and ports, while M54 raw core has no matching telemetry wrapper.
P0.impact: Using the bridge as the M66 DC top would attribute instrumentation area and timing to lookahead and invalidate the comparison.
P0.closure: Hard-reject the bridge SHA and admit only the two listed raw core tops.

P1.finding: M66 deliberately changes cycle-level launch_ready, launch_accept and active-state behavior.
P1.impact: Direct M54-to-M66 LEC is expected to fail or require assumptions that erase the innovation.
P1.closure: Run two RTL-to-own-netlist Formality jobs with the exact arm SVFs; keep cross-variant behavior proof in the VCS/SVA seam miter.

P1.finding: The raw core exposes 8597 input and 2061 output bits, including a 6144-bit response bus.
P1.impact: Missing I/O delays or mixing an I/O path with internal reg-to-reg timing can create optimistic or misleading frequency claims.
P1.closure: Use the one complete SDC, fail on every unconstrained category and report the four path groups separately.

P1.finding: An A/B is not reproducible if SVF, tool, library, SDC, command or report bytes are only named but not frozen before and after execution.
P1.impact: A coordinated rerun or mismatched corner can manufacture an apparent delta.
P1.closure: Freeze the common launch manifest, hash each arm SVF/netlist/report and independently reconstruct the receipt.

P1.finding: A fixed 3.000 ns report proves only pass or fail at that constraint and its stated I/O model.
P1.impact: Converting WNS directly into an Fmax claim ignores path class, uncertainty, I/O budget and resynthesis effects.
P1.closure: Cite fixed-period WNS/TNS only; use a separate identical-recipe timing sweep if Fmax is later required.
